Done! The sync script is now scheduled to run every 15 minutes on this machine and will persist after reboots. 

**Task Details:**
- **Task Name:** SentinelSync
- **Frequency:** Every 15 minutes (PT15M)
- **Script:** `scripts/sync.sh`
- **Working Directory:** Your repo root
- **Persistence:** Configured to run for 10,000 days (essentially indefinitely), surviving reboots

The task will begin executing in approximately 15 minutes and will continue running at that interval. You can view its status anytime with: `Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName "SentinelSync"` or manage it through Windows Task Scheduler (`taskschd.msc`).
